candidate_set: residents not requested by the current event (current-event shield); if empty, all residents (total fallback). Features are computed only for candidates.

clocks.i: served step index (trace step number) of the current event
clocks.j: global served-event index: 0-based position in the list of (step, layer, experts) events served by the frozen replay loop (all served steps, prefill and decode, layer order 0..47 within a step; layers with no request are not events)
clocks.n_l: per-layer event counter: number of served events of layer l strictly before the current moment

exposure_attestation: The vocabulary was written on 2026-11-22 from the request text, Research 3 mechanisms (current-event shield, last-observed set) and the cited literature. No VALIDATION or EVAL statistic was read in Phase 0. Prior EVAL exposure is limited to R2-10 predictor recall@k (DATA_SPLITS).

features.initial_value: n/a: a resident key has been requested at least at admission
features.name: events_since_last_ref
features.tie_semantics: integer; ranking ties per model rule
features.update_timing: on every request of k (hit or admission)

features.causal_justification: past requests only; decay 0.99 per served step (the frozen decayed_transition decay)
features.definition: floor(2^16 * S_k(i_now)), S_k(i) = sum over past requests r of k of 0.99^(i - i_r); request at the current event excluded
features.name: decayed_count_fx
features.update_timing: S updated lazily on request: S <- S*0.99^(i - i_last) + 1; evaluated at decision

features.definition: j_now - j_admit(k) for the current residency
features.name: events_since_admission

features.definition: number of requests of k served as hits since its current admission
features.name: hits_since_admission

features.definition: number of admissions of k before the current one, since replay start
features.name: reload_count

features.definition: n_l at the last request of k minus n_l at the request before it
features.initial_value: sentinel 1000000 if k has fewer than 2 past requests
features.name: prev_reuse_interval

features.definition: floor(sum of all past inter-request intervals of k / their count)
features.initial_value: sentinel 1000000 if fewer than 2 past requests
features.name: mean_reuse_interval

features.causal_justification: the last completed event of the candidate's own layer
features.definition: 1 if expert e was requested by layer l's most recent served event strictly before the current event, else 0
features.initial_value: 0 if layer l has no previous event
features.name: in_prev_layer_event
features.update_timing: after each served event of layer l

features.definition: floor(1000 * resident_bytes / budget_bytes) immediately before this eviction
features.name: occupancy_permille
features.tie_semantics: integer; identical for all candidates of a decision

features.definition: number of missed experts of the current event not yet admitted, including the one being admitted
features.name: pending_misses
features.tie_semantics: integer; identical for all candidates of a decision

features.definition: rank of k among the decision's candidates by j_last_ref descending (0 = most recent); ties by (layer, expert) ascending
features.name: recency_rank

features.definition: rank of k among the decision's candidates by F02 descending (0 = highest); ties by F01 ascending, then (layer, expert) ascending
features.name: frequency_rank

features.definition: byte size of k as given by the replay context (ctx.bytes_of(layer))
features.name: expert_bytes

features.causal_justification: fixed layer execution order of the architecture; uses no routing of later events
features.definition: ((l - L_now - 1) mod 48) + 1 where L_now is the current event's layer
features.name: layer_cycle_offset

forbidden_inputs: any request of a future event
EVAL or VALIDATION statistics of any kind
NUE_X / decayed_transition predicted sets (kept as a comparator, not a feature, so CHEAP stays predictor-free)
freeze_rule: No feature may be added, removed or redefined after Phase 0.
scope: one replay per trace, cold cache at trace start; every clock, feature history and label spans all served events of that trace (prefill and decode); only decode-event misses are scored; nothing carries over between traces.
state_snapshot: after all previous events and after the current event's requests processed so far (experts processed in ascending expert id; hits update state before misses are admitted in that order); the request being admitted is known.
